title: UnGANable: Defending Against GAN-based Face Manipulation
reasoning: The paper explicitly states its motivation in terms of combating 'severe threats of visual misinformation to our society' and preventing the misuse of face manipulation techniques for 'malicious purposes, such as misinformation generation' and 'violating individual privacy or even misleading political opinions'. The 'Threat Model' section further elaborates on these concerns, indicating that the paper addresses ethical implications of technology misuse.
